title: THE BORROWED MOMENT
author: Snehaprava Das
text:
I hold on to this one moment
I have borrowed
From the eternity
I hold it in a tight grip,
This one single moment with you
Makes my whole world,
I live in and out of it
Travelling within its vast fullness
And in the void around
That one moment with you
Is my rainbowing spring
And drenching rain,
That is the infinity of my sky
And all the oceans
I drink it to quell an endless thirst
Breathe it to live beyond time
It drops and breaks
Again and again
But I tirelessly gather
our broken images
In its trick mirror and put them
In their right places
In the unendinly going on
Jigsaw puzzle
To make a `today` out of it.
